summary: This is a documentation file that describes an Intent-Driven Interface Builder — a tool that lets you describe what you want a user interface to do, and it automatically generates the actual UI for you instead of making you manually build it piece by piece. It uses AI and a library of pre-made components to figure out which widgets to use, how to arrange them, and what they should look like.

explanations.3: This is metadata telling the build system (when you run 'make builder') that this file has some partial data associated with it.
explanations.15: This is a template tag that pulls in shared instructions from another file about how to run this builder — it's a way to reuse the same instructions across multiple documentation pages without copying them.
